scope: gun walk/run lower-body crop and splice only

directionReference.camera: same approved player skeleton camera and body axis
directionReference.notes: Weapon direction is not used as a body-direction reference. Existing approved gun leg trajectory remains authoritative.

run: preserve the approved discrete leg frames
shift every frame right by 4 px as one action-wide crop decision
restore only the missing upper splice band from the matching full-body run frame
keep the approved leg frame as the topmost source of truth
walk: crop the unused 4 px trailing column
keep the approved foot line, stride, root position and discrete frame timing unchanged
extend only the upper hip splice band by up to 6 px vertically and 8 px laterally using pixels from the same frame
require non-zero alpha-128 torso contact for every configured frame at -40, 0 and +40 degrees
